# HakiAPI

> HakiAPI is a production-grade Python API client engine designed to stop developers from rewriting authentication, exponential retries, pagination, and error handling boilerplate.

## Documentation

- [Introduction](https://hakiapi.pages.dev/docs/introduction): Overview of HakiAPI, core goals, and why resilient API clients matter.
- [Installation](https://hakiapi.pages.dev/docs/installation): How to install HakiAPI using pip or poetry.
- [Quick Start](https://hakiapi.pages.dev/docs/quick-start): Build your first resilient API client in under 5 minutes.
- [Authentication](https://hakiapi.pages.dev/docs/auth): Managing API keys, tokens, and secure headers.
- [Retries & Exponential Backoff](https://hakiapi.pages.dev/docs/retry): Configuring automatic retry logic for transient network failures.
- [Paginator](https://hakiapi.pages.dev/docs/paginator): Handling cursor-based and offset pagination automatically.
- [Exceptions & Error Mapping](https://hakiapi.pages.dev/docs/exceptions): Standardized exception handling across different HTTP status codes.
- [Circuit Breaker](https://hakiapi.pages.dev/docs/circuit-breaker): Protecting downstream systems from cascading failures.
- [Async Client](https://hakiapi.pages.dev/docs/async-client): Building high-performance asynchronous API clients with asyncio.
- [OAuth 2.0 Engine](https://hakiapi.pages.dev/docs/oauth): Full OAuth flows with token refresh and persistent token storage.

## Bundled Clients & Examples

- [GitHub Client](https://hakiapi.pages.dev/docs/github-client): GraphQL-powered GitHub client implementation.
- [Gmail & Calendar Client](https://hakiapi.pages.dev/docs/gmail-client): Production SDK examples for Google Workspace integrations.
- [Architecture](https://hakiapi.pages.dev/architecture): Complete lifecycle breakdown of an API request through HakiAPI.
- [Roadmap](https://hakiapi.pages.dev/roadmap): Version history, release philosophy, and upcoming features like the Predictive Rate-Limit Governor.
